settings.gfixPath.description: Path to the gfix binary. Defaults to 'gfix' (resolved via PATH).
settings.codeLens.enabled.description: Show inline CodeLens buttons above git conflict markers.
settings.aiProvider.description: AI suggestion source. 'host' uses VS Code's Language Model API (Copilot, etc.). 'byok' uses keys from ~/.config/gitfix/keys.toml or env. 'none' disables AI.
settings.ai.budgetWarningAt.description: Show a notification when AI suggestion count reaches this number (default budget is 10/merge).
settings.mergeStrategy.description: Default strategy when invoking gitfix_merge_preview. 'auto' lets gfix pick (mergiraf for supported languages, text otherwise).
settings.allowRerere.description: Allow rerere cache replay during merge_preview. Disable to force fresh resolution.
settings.protectedBranches.description: Branches that require explicit confirmation in Apply Merge.
settings.telemetry.enabled.description: Send anonymized usage telemetry. Honors vscode.env.isTelemetryEnabled — disabled if VS Code-wide telemetry is off.
